transactions.sale_price_citation: Divestment highlights table p9: 'Courtyard by Marriott Sydney-North Ryde | Sydney, Australia | AUD109.0M (S$95.6M) | 5% [Premium over book value] | 4.4% [Exit yield] | Jan 2024'
transactions.citation: Divestment highlights table p9: 'Courtyard by Marriott Sydney-North Ryde | Sydney, Australia | AUD109.0M (S$95.6M) | 5% [Premium over book value] | 4.4% [Exit yield] | Jan 2024'; Note 14 (p8383): 'the CapitaLand Ascott BT Group completed the divestment of Courtyard by Marriott Sydney-North Ryde in Australia for a consideration of $48.6 million'
transactions.notes: gain_loss_pct (5%) is AR-DISCLOSED, from the highlights table which pairs it with a sale price of S$95.6M (AUD109.0M); reference_value = book_value derived from THAT same paired sale price (95.6M / 1.05 = 91,047,619). FLAG: the audited Note 14/Note 8 (p8383) discloses a materially different consideration figure, $48.6 million, for the same divestment — roughly half of the highlights-table figure: 'the CapitaLand Ascott BT Group completed the divestment of Courtyard by Marriott Sydney-North Ryde in Australia for a consideration of $48.6 million'. The AR does not reconcile this discrepancy anywhere found; per spec rule 5 ('never balance by assumption') and the V2 addendum, BOTH figures are preserved rather than silently choosing one — sale_price uses the Divestment Highlights figure (S$95.6M) per the addendum's explicit instruction, while the Note 8 figure ($48.6M) is quoted here for the record, not discarded. The % and reference_value use the highlights-table pair (internally consistent with each other) since Note 8 discloses no percentage of its own.

transactions.citation: Divestment highlights table p9: 'Hotel WBF Honmachi | Osaka, Japan | JPY10.7B (S$99.8M) | 15% [Premium over book value] | Not meaningful [Exit yield] | Mar 2024', with rows 4-5 (Kitasemba East, Kitasemba West) left blank in the same table, indicating the aggregate figures apply to the trio; Note 14 (p8387): 'the CapitaLand Ascott REIT Group completed the divestment of three hotels in Japan for a total consideration of $96.3 million. The three properties are Hotel WBF Honmachi, Hotel WBF Kitasemba East and Hotel WBF Kitasemba West'
transactions.notes: AGGREGATE DEAL — one divestment, three hotels, ONE consideration and ONE premium%; no per-property split disclosed anywhere. All three property rows share this deal_id and repeat the deal-level gain_loss_pct (15%, disclosed) and reference_value. reference_value = book_value derived from the highlights-table paired sale price: 99,800,000/1.15 = 86,782,609. FLAG: as with North Ryde, the highlights-table aggregate sale price (S$99.8M) differs from the audited Note 14 aggregate consideration (S$96.3M); both are preserved (Note 14 figure in citation only, not used for the % calc since it carries no disclosed premium of its own). Exit yield explicitly 'Not meaningful' per AR footnote (properties largely closed in 2022).

CLAS' total investment cost for 100% of the property is USD103.6M (S$139.3M) ... 7.0% ... May 2024'
transactions.notes: interest_pct = 0.10, the incremental stake acquired via call-option exercise, taking CLAS to 100% ownership (was already majority-owner). purchase_price for the 10% tranche specifically is NOT separately disclosed — only 'CLAS' total investment cost for 100% of the property' (USD103.6M / S$139.3M) is given, which is a cumulative/blended figure covering the original stake plus this acquisition, not the price of this transaction alone. Left null rather than assumed as 10% of the total (would be an unsupported pro-rata guess).
